\begin{quote}
\textbf{Roommates:} Two roommates each need to choose to clean their apartment, and each can choose an amount of time \(t_i \ge 0\) to clean. If their choices are \(t_i\) and \(t_j\), then player \(i\)'s payoff is given by \((10 - t_j)t_i - t_i^2\). (This payoff function implies that the more one roommate cleans, the less valuable is cleaning for the other roommate.)

\begin{enumerate}
\def\labelenumi{\alph{enumi}.}
\item
  What is the best response correspondence of each player \(i\)?
\item
  Which choices survive one round of IESDS?
\item
  Which choices survive IESDS?
\end{enumerate}
\end{quote}
